follow_up_email.subject: Elastic Cloud Reference Architecture and POC Outline for Northwind Pay EU Deployment
follow_up_email.body_markdown:
Hi Mike,

Thanks for the productive technical deep dive today on your EU workload topology. As committed, I'm sending over the Elastic Cloud reference architecture diagram and POC outline covering Frankfurt and Dublin regions with our recommended tiered storage approach (hot i3, warm d3, cold searchable snapshots on GCS).

Please review with your platform team at your earliest convenience, with particular focus on:

- Region and node sizing validation for your EU deployment
- Index lifecycle policies (7 day hot, 30 day warm, 7 year cold retention)
- Cross-cluster search vs. cross-cluster replication for your break-glass investigation workflows and regulatory requirements

Once your team has had a chance to review, let's schedule a follow-up to discuss any questions and confirm next steps toward the POC.

Best regards,
Rodrigo
